english_question: What measures can be taken to prevent fungal diseases during maize flowering in Olokiti, Ido/Onikede/Okuna Awo, Ido, Oyo, Nigeria?

Use general categories like copper-based fungicides or sulfur-based products, which are often available locally. english_question: What nutrients do pepper plants need during the flowering stage in Jobele, Oyo, Nigeria?
